representation.affine_layer: GF(2) linear system maintained in canonical RREF
representation.nonlinear_layer: hash-consed shared Boolean DAG with bounded-fanin AND/OR/NOT nodes and explicit live outputs
representation.semantics: conjunction of affine equations and DAG output constraints

fresh_aux_rules.reintroduction_rule: a rewrite may not replace one live semantic degree by an equisized fresh alias set while claiming progress

progress_accounting.primary_measure: number of live semantic interface bits after quotienting definitional aliases
progress_accounting.secondary_measure: number of unresolved nonlinear DAG outputs that still depend on at least one live semantic interface bit
progress_accounting.tertiary_measure: canonical DAG node count plus affine row count
progress_accounting.required_order: lexicographic strict decrease of a polynomially bounded certified potential at every macro-step
progress_accounting.certificate_requirement: the checker must independently verify every claimed alias quotient and progress decrement

success_condition: prove one uniform deterministic exact polynomial bound for representation size, macro-step count, macro-step time, SAT reconstruction and independent UNSAT replay on every PAIR+OR_3 input
failure_condition: freeze a family forcing superpolynomial DAG/RREF size, superpolynomial certified macro-steps, or an anti-alias/progress violation
